title: Easy, Hard, Tall
label: ch:mr-easy-hard-tall
canDo: I can say a thing is easy or difficult and a person is tall, and I can sort every adjective I own into the two classes by looking at its last letter.

payoff.summary: Complete MR-R52-easy-hard-tall and describe a person in three sentences -- tall, clever, a good friend -- which is the shape the A1 speaking paper's one-minute description asks for.
payoff.note: The payoff is a described PERSON, not a described thing: uMch against moTHaa is the distinction English blurs and the speaking paper needs.
